searchText: The EL Crawler reports over 1000+ Nethermind nodes going offline over past few days on mainnet. But similar pattern happens on testnets as well. It's across various client versions so not an issue triggered by recent update but seems like they have an issue with discovery network. Anyone else noticed some problems connecting to Nerhemind nodes? https://www.ethernets.io/?client-name=nethermind&graph-format=number&interval=24h&network=1&synced=yes Yup the nethermind team is aware and fixing, its to do with a stricter check that was shipped Yeah we are on top of this
